answer: A newcomer takes a jade mortgage: it borrows a 10 POA bond from a public crystal ledger and repays it from its first earnings, so honest work clears the debt and the identity keeps the rest. The mortgage is willow-rooted to its funding wallet — if the identity is proven fake, the unpaid debt stays on the wallet and blocks every new identity it funds until repaid. The nth identity from one wallet owes 10n POA, so the 1st fake owes 10, the 10th owes 100, 550 POA across ten, and each new mortgage needs a distinct stranger to co-sign the debt. Fakes pay in real future earnings they never collect.
